predecessors.name: Xin dynasty
predecessors.text: Hubei, the Xin province where the Lülin bands rose

successors.name: Han dynasty
successors.text: the Lülin lands, which become the Gengshi Emperor's restored Han

ledger.x: About 17: the Lülin bands rise in Hubei.
About 17: the Lülin contest Hubei with the Xin; a mirror of the xin-dynasty ledger.
23: the Lülin are absorbed by the Gengshi Emperor's restored Han.

wars.name: Lülin and Chimei rebellions (fall of the Xin)
wars.outcome: Rebellions from about 17 became a civil war by 19; the restorationist armies beat the Xin at Kunyang in June-July 23 and took Chang'an on 4-5 October.

certainty.note: No page gives a boundary for the Lülin lands; Hubei is a province proxy.
